name: git-diff-viewer
description: Browse all local git changes in a single windowed view with collapsible per-file side-by-side diffs. Compatible with VS Code and Antigravity.

commands.title: Git Diff Viewer: Open Local Changes

gitDiffViewer.autoOpenOnStartup.description: Automatically open the Git Changes panel when the editor starts in a git repository.

gitDiffViewer.autoOpenFocus.description: Steal focus when the panel auto-opens. When false, the panel opens beside your current editor without disturbing it.

gitDiffViewer.openRouterApiKey.markdownDescription: OpenRouter API key used for AI-powered commit messages, reviews, and change analysis. Get one at [openrouter.ai/keys](https://openrouter.ai/keys). Stored in your user settings; you can also set `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` in `~/.env` as a fallback.

gitDiffViewer.model.markdownDescription: OpenRouter model id used for all AI features (commit messages, reviews, per-file analysis). Any model on [openrouter.ai/models](https://openrouter.ai/models) works. Per-task overrides: `#gitDiffViewer.analysisModel#`, `#gitDiffViewer.reviewModel#`, `#gitDiffViewer.commitModel#`.

gitDiffViewer.analysisModel.description: Optional OpenRouter model override for per-file change analysis. Empty = use gitDiffViewer.model.

gitDiffViewer.reviewModel.description: Optional OpenRouter model override for Review All / architecture overview. Empty = use gitDiffViewer.model.

gitDiffViewer.commitModel.description: Optional OpenRouter model override for commit message generation. Empty = use gitDiffViewer.model.

gitDiffViewer.autoAnalyze.description: Automatically run change analysis (Architect Doc) whenever the changeset changes. In-flight runs are cancelled and restarted; unchanged files reuse cached results.

enumDescriptions: Only local static analysis (fallow) — no network calls.
Only remote LLM analysis via OpenRouter.
Local static analysis + remote LLM analysis (default).
gitDiffViewer.analysisMode.description: Which analysis engines feed the Architect Doc.

gitDiffViewer.fallowPath.markdownDescription: Path to the [fallow](https://github.com/fallow-rs/fallow) CLI used for local static analysis. Section is skipped gracefully if the binary is missing.

gitDiffViewer.analysisConcurrency.description: Max concurrent per-file LLM analysis requests.

gitDiffViewer.experimentalMap.description: Enable the experimental Code Map — a zoomable circle-packed bubble view of the repo showing change heat, quality, review progress, and import links.

enumDescriptions: Small — narrow columns, more files per row (~560px each).
Medium — comfortable side-by-side diffs (~840px each, default).
Large — wide columns for long lines (~1200px each).
gitDiffViewer.gridSize.description: Minimum width preset for each file panel in grid view. The toolbar's grid size button can cycle through these in-session.
